Act11-2#1.zh: 本人是三都缉捕使臣何涛，这位是押司宋江；你们这里是谁负责啊？到底发生什么事啊？
Act11-2#1.t: I am He Tao, Inspector of Arrests for the three districts, and this is Clerk Song Jiang. Who's in charge here? What on earth happened?

Act11-2#2.zh: 在下大名府管军提辖使杨志。奉梁中书命，追查『生辰纲』的下落。这些贼人都是我们逮捕的；正好交给何观察。这些金银请先由官府查封，我们还要去东溪村追查人犯。
Act11-2#2.t: I am Yang Zhi, Military Major of Daming Prefecture, ordered by Secretary Liang to trace the 'birthday gifts'. We caught these bandits; I'll hand them over to you, Inspector He. Please have the officials seal this gold and silver first. We still have to go to East Creek Village after the culprits.

Act11-2#3.zh: 哦，这个小寨能够查到多少金银...喔！这么多啊！
Act11-2#3.t: Oh, how much silver could a little stronghold like this hold... Oh! That much!

Act11-2#5.t: (Oh no! Isn't that 'Timely Rain' Song Jiang?)

Act11-2#6.zh: 在下都管林二，初次见面。
Act11-2#6.t: I'm Steward Lin Er. A pleasure to meet you.

Act11-2#7.zh: (他明明是八十万禁军教头『豹子头』林冲啊？大概是有什么难言之隐吧...)
Act11-2#7.t: (He's clearly Lin Chong, the 'Panther Head', instructor of the eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards. He must have his reasons...)

Act11-2#9.zh: 何观察，那么我们还有人犯要追，不多停留了。
Act11-2#9.t: Inspector He, we still have culprits to chase, so we won't stay.

Act11-2#10.zh: 宋押司，这些人犯你就先押解回去关起来。
Act11-2#10.t: Clerk Song, take these prisoners back and lock them up first.

Act11-2#12.zh: 这附近一定还有漏网之鱼，我要好好搜查一下。
Act11-2#12.t: There must be some who slipped the net around here. I'll search thoroughly.

Act11-2#13.zh: (哼...犯人在东溪村啊；如果捉到的话可是大功一件啊！再说，如果没有杨志这批人的话，功劳全是我何涛的；呈报回朝廷的金银珠宝我也可以动些手脚...呵呵呵...)
Act11-2#13.t: (Hmph... so the culprits are in East Creek Village. Catch them and it's a great merit! Besides, without Yang Zhi's lot, all the credit would be mine, He Tao's. And I could skim a little off the gold and jewels I report to the court... heh heh heh...)

Act11-2#14.zh: 何涛为满足私欲，追查『生辰纲』的下落。
Act11-2#14.t: He Tao chases the 'birthday gifts' for his own greed.
